explanation: Although some round-ups claim thumbs-up is an offensive 'phallic' gesture across a broadly defined 'Middle East,' Turkey-specific sources that do catalogue real taboo gestures (the OK sign, the fig gesture) never flag thumbs-up, and it's commonly used and read positively in Turkey, much like in the West.
local_tip: Thumbs-up is safe to use in everyday and business settings in Turkey; it's understood the same positive way as in the West.

also_check.note: Thumbs-up is a severe insult, roughly equivalent to a raised middle finger.
Considered an obscene gesture, similar to the middle finger in Western cultures.
Thumbs-up means 'good' and is read positively, though less used for 'okay' than in the West.

sources.title: Not bad intentions, it's just etiquette in Turkey
